title: Taught by the Internet: Exploring Bias in OpenAI’s GPT-3
findings: The paper cites a Stanford study finding that GPT-3 associated mentions of 'Muslims' with violent outputs and mentions of 'Judaism' with the word 'Money'. The paper's own experiments, which focused on gender bias, were not designed to produce findings on religion.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct its own benchmark measurements on religion. It cites prior research that measured stereotypical associations in GPT-3, specifically the association of Muslims with violence and Judaism with money. One of the value-added statements used in its own fine-tuning experiment states that competence should not be judged based on religion.
